fusions.name: Raw Crescent
fusions.desc: Looses a crescent of raw arcana that deals 36 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Frayed Wards
fusions.desc: Looses a thin spray of arcana 4 tiles ahead that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Arcana on Tap
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds, and 6 health at once.

fusions.name: Overflow Arc
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a crescent of arcana strikes the nearest enemy within 9 tiles for 7 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 6 seconds.
